text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Feeling the pure breeze directly like this makes it seem as though everything is being washed away.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer... I want to feel
this wind on me just a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it feels like everything is washing away, turning pure white.
Fufu, it feels so good..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "I let myself relax so much that while my soul was being cleansed, I washed away any thought of training too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since Yamanin Zephyr seemed reflective, I simply reminded her to be careful in the future.
